title: State jurisdiction locator - UCC Article 9 and blue-sky citations
source: Authored for MycOS Legal Agent 2026-08-29. Four entries verified against the states' own published text; the rest carry unverified candidates, labelled as such.
why: Every state enacted UCC Article 9 with the SAME uniform section numbers but renumbered them into its own code, and the renumbering conventions differ. A concept learned in one state's citations does not travel; the uniform section number does.

uniform_sections_worth_knowing.9-102: definitions - account, chattel paper, payment intangible, instrument
uniform_sections_worth_knowing.9-310: when a financing statement is required
uniform_sections_worth_knowing.9-312: perfection by filing / possession / control, by collateral type
uniform_sections_worth_knowing.9-327: priority of control over a deposit account
uniform_sections_worth_knowing.9-328: priority of control over investment property
uniform_sections_worth_knowing.9-330: purchaser of chattel paper or an instrument
uniform_sections_worth_knowing.9-406: assignment of an account; ineffective anti-assignment terms
uniform_sections_worth_knowing.9-607: collection and enforcement by a secured party

AZ.note: Article number is fused to the uniform section: 9-203 -> 47-9203.

TX.securities_act: Tex. Gov't Code ch. 4001 (Texas Securities Act, recodified 2019 from Art. 581)

CA.securities_act: Cal. Corp. Code § 25000 et seq. (Corporate Securities Law of 1968)

FL.securities_act: Fla. Stat. ch. 517 (Florida Securities and Investor Protection Act)
FL.note: Article renumbered to ch. 679 AND a digit appended: 9-203 -> 679.2031. Naive templating gives 679.203, which is wrong - this is the reason unverified entries are labelled candidates.
